name: Brago
description: Ambitious young count who became king and Selvala's close friend; suffered from an incurable disease.

description_citations.text: "Selvala of Alberon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selvala kills the immortal Brago, inadvertently releasing him as a spirit to rule eternally.
timeline.quote: his ally Selvala of Alberon killed him

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to put Brago to rest.
timeline.quote: the noblewoman Marchesa d'Amati hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to finally put Brago to rest

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Goblin gangs stalk Fiora's city after Brago's death.
timeline.quote: violent Goblin gangs stalked the city, stirring up unrest and plundering

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Fiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grenzo secures a post as Dungeon Keeper of Brago.
timeline.quote: the goblin Grenzo managed to secure himself a position as Dungeon Keeper of Brago

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Fiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At a private dinner, Selvala tells the withered King Brago that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments.
timeline.quote: I begged you not to let the Custodi begin their treatments.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: young Count Brago sees the potential of the City and recognizes he cannot walk the path to it alone.
timeline.quote: And he could not walk it alone.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
timeline.quote: Together, they drafted the Charter.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: three years into his reign, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical preservation treatments.
timeline.quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala accuses Brago of valuing his own life above those he served and says she would call any other man who spoke so a tyrant.
timeline.quote: if I heard those words from any other man's lips, I would know him to be a tyrant.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Brago reveals there will be no more treatments because they have gone too far, and begs Selvala to kill him.
timeline.quote: I cannot die naturally. But I think I must die.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala forgives Brago and stabs him through the heart; his body crumbles to dust as he whispers that she will not, and she is escorted from the room.
timeline.quote: His ancient body began to crumble almost immediately

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Brago's spirit appears in a blue mist and orders the Custodi to announce that the king has risen and that their work is complete; they hail him as King Eternal.
timeline.quote: All hail Brago, King Eternal.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Muzzio explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says the vice chancellorship would have given him the autonomy for the next phase; Brago's death and seeming ascension made the board cautious.
timeline.quote: But the death of Brago and his seeming ascension, which I couldn't foresee, caused them to vote more cautiously.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Grenzo asks what it is like to kill a man you love, and Selvala answers that it is all too easy; he unlocks the cell door.
timeline.quote: Selvala said, "All too easy."

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo leads Selvala through the tunnels under Paliano, pointing out the palace, Brago's bedchamber, Sydri's shop and the treasury.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the map of Paliano began to make sense to her

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Adriana stands guard as King Brago, now a paranoid ghost, meets with two Custodi ghosts in the great dining hall.
timeline.quote: King Brago sat at the head of his dining room table before a clean plate and sparkling silverware

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
timeline.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
timeline.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
timeline.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa reveals she dealt with Brago's descendants so that her name was next in succession.
timeline.quote: I dealt with them a while ago, however, and it just so happened that my name was next in the line of succession.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
timeline.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa announces to the people that King Brago is no more and has passed beyond the veil.
timeline.quote: Brago, King of Paliano, is no more.

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa declares herself Brago's designated heir, recognized by the Custodi, and vows to uphold the laws of Paliano.
timeline.quote: As his designated heir, recognized by the sacred order of Custodi as his one true successor

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering King Brago and forging his will and of commanding the Custodi.
timeline.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana urges the citizens to stand with her and Brago and disobey the pretender.
timeline.quote: stand with me, and with Brago, and show your loyalty to your city through your disobedience to the pretender.

citation.work: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard
citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold notes that on the day of her ascension Marchesa decorated the throne room, guards and capital with Black Rose emblems, doubting her claim of Brago's will.
timeline.quote: the throne room is immediately decorated in Black Rose tapestries

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold relays rumors that an assassin infiltrated the palace, possibly walking through walls, to kill Brago, and that the queen's crown now glows with his energy.
timeline.quote: an assassin infiltrated the palace, by some accounts walking through stone walls, in order to reach Brago's chambers.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Leovold recounts that Selvala once drafted the Charter with Brago and was repaid with betrayal and imprisonment (backstory).
timeline.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Brago seizes power and rules Paliano; he and the Custodi close the Academy to eliminate opponents.
timeline.quote: The King and his Custodi advisors closed down the Academy using the opportunity to eliminate those who stood against him.

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brago attains immortality as a spirit with his advisors' help.
timeline.quote: he attained immortality with the help of his advisors which inadvertently freed him from his body as a spirit

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selvala of Alberon kills Brago.
timeline.quote: Brago was killed by Selvala of Alberon

citation.text: "Paliano", section "King Brago". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to eliminate Brago for good.
timeline.quote: hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to eliminate the king for good

citation.text: "Paliano", section "Queen Marchesa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selvala and Brago rise in Fiora's ruling class and draft the Charter.
timeline.quote: Together with Brago, she drafted the Charter.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selvala kills the incurably ill, over-treated King Brago with a dagger as an act of mercy.
timeline.quote: Selvala ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Murderer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Brago's spirit and the Black Rose usurps the crown.
timeline.quote: Brago's spirit was killed by the planeswalker Kaya

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Reign of the Black Rose". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: The immortal King Eternal of Paliano, once a living man and Selvala's friend, whose body was preserved by the Custodi until Selvala killed him.

citation.text: "Betrayal" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 May 2014.

pages_say.description: The king whose death and seeming ascension made the board vote more cautiously.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

pages_say.description: Selvala's friend, whom she stabbed; Grenzo says he had secret plots, and his bedchamber lies in the palace.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The ghostly King Eternal of Fiora, whose rule persists beyond death.

citation.text: Conspiracy: card flavor text (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The ghost king of Paliano, paranoid and crueler in death than in life, who is assassinated by Kaya.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: The long-reigning king of Paliano, whose ghost has now passed beyond the veil according to Marchesa's proclamation.

citation.text: "Proclamation by Queen Marchesa" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: The immortal king of Paliano whom Adriana says was murdered by Marchesa.

citation.text: "Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2016.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.
